_meta.purpose: Expected-run registry for the fleet-health-routine. Lists what SHOULD run at each cadence and where it writes, so the beacon can compute 'did NOT emit today' (dormant-routine detection — the git-hygiene-dormant + 3-week-dark-producer failure classes). Keep in sync with D:\orryx-standards\routines\routine-schedule.json.
_meta.v2_change: Added the 7 non-fleet scheduled tasks that were live but invisible to dormancy detection (FH-45), sourced from routine-schedule.json non_fleet_tasks. They sit in the normal daily/weekly buckets so existing cadence filtering picks them up unchanged.
_meta.out_verified: true = an artifact matching the {out} template was found on disk, so a miss is real evidence of dormancy. false = the routine is CONTRACTED by its SKILL.md to write this path but has never been observed doing so; report a miss as 'unproven path OR dormant', NEVER as confirmed dormancy, until the first artifact appears. Absent field = treat as true (all v1 entries were verified in use).
_meta.out_null: out:null means the task emits to the session only BY DESIGN and cannot be dormancy-checked by file existence - fall back to the exit log alone and never emit a DORMANT row for it. Do not invent a path for these; a fabricated template produces a false DORMANT every cycle forever.
